page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% tier, and single-threaded gzip compression ranking in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, consistently achieve average performance within the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests also demonstrate average capabilities, with read-only small block cached speeds at 2284.31 GB/sec and uncached large block read speeds at 104.82 GB/sec.

The resource density of 56 dedicated cores combined with 224.0 GB of RAM offers a balanced hardware profile for multi-threaded workloads. While single-threaded tasks are constrained by the older processor architecture, the instance maintains average throughput for parallel operations such as software compilation, database operations, and static web serving. It is suitable for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded data processing, and web serving environments that can leverage the high core count without requiring local SSD storage or GPU acceleration.
